summary: Comprehensive comparison of 15+ open-source SLMs for cybersecurity vulnerability detection, updated for September 2026. Includes the latest models: Qwen 3 Coder-Next, Gemma 3, Llama 4 Scout, DeepSeek V4-Flash, Cisco Foundation-Sec-8B, and more. Organized into tiers (Best Overall, Laptop-Friendly, Security-Specialized) with hardware requirements, licensing, and final recommendation.
